big_story.headline: Mahanadi Coalfields Opens ₹8,981 Cr IPO
big_story.subhead: COAL INDIA SUBSIDIARY SETS PRICE BAND AT ₹129-136 AS LIC LEADS ANCHOR ALLOCATION
paragraphs: Mahanadi Coalfields, a subsidiary of Coal India, opened its ₹8,981 crore initial public offering today with a price band set between ₹129 and ₹136 per share. Ahead of the issue opening, the company successfully raised ₹2,295 crore from anchor investors, with Life Insurance Corporation of India leading the buying. Investors are closely watching subscription status and expected listing gains as the public offer hits the market.

The massive state-owned coal producer's IPO marks a significant primary market event, showcasing strong institutional demand during the anchor round. Anchor investors locked in their positions prior to the launch, providing momentum to the issue. The grey market premium for the stock has already shown an uptick of 2.3% ahead of bidding.

As retail and institutional bidding gets underway, market participants are watching whether public enthusiasm matches anchor interest. The listing will test investor appetite for state-owned commodity producers amid evolving global market conditions. Retail buyers can calculate lot sizes and potential returns as subscription numbers roll in over the coming days.
big_story.pullbox: With ₹2,295 crore already secured from anchor investors led by LIC, Mahanadi Coalfields' ₹8,981 crore issue is set to test primary market appetite.

explains.title: What is an Anchor Investor?
paragraphs: An anchor investor is a qualified institutional buyer invited to subscribe to shares ahead of an initial public offering opening to the general public. This mechanism helps build market confidence and establish price stability before retail bidding begins.

In India, anchor allocations require institutional investors to commit capital at a fixed price within the defined price band. Their early involvement provides a strong signal to retail and high-net-worth investors about institutional backing for the issue.

Indian AI startup Humyn Labs has raised $47 million in funding to feed US robotics companies the data they need. The startup focuses on generating and curating high-quality training datasets essential for building next-generation autonomous systems and intelligent robots.

The substantial capital injection reflects growing international demand for specialised AI data infrastructure. Humyn Labs aims to scale its operations to support global robotics developers who rely heavily on structured real-world data for machine learning models.

story_1.headline: Indian economic growth seen at annual 7.6%
paragraphs: India's economic growth is projected at an annual 7.6% in the July-September quarter, according to a recent Reuters poll. This robust expansion highlights the country's underlying economic momentum despite various global headwinds.
Policymakers and market participants continue to monitor these key quarterly indicators closely as indicators of broader macroeconomic health.

story_2.headline: India's capital markets growing rapidly
paragraphs: Prime Minister Narendra Modi noted that India's capital markets are growing rapidly alongside the broader economy. This expansion reflects deeper financial inclusion and increasing participation from retail and institutional investors alike.
The development of robust market infrastructure remains a key priority for sustainable long-term economic prosperity.

story_3.headline: India ranks 1st in economic resilience
paragraphs: India has secured the top rank in economic resilience, underscoring its strong macroeconomic fundamentals. The achievement highlights the country's capacity to navigate volatile global economic conditions successfully.

geopolitics.headline: India-US Trade Deal Nears Finish Line
paragraphs: Trade negotiations between New Delhi and Washington have reached their final stretch, with a pact drawing close to completion. However, official signing of the agreement remains paused as authorities await the rollout of a new US tariff framework.

While negotiators work through the remaining policy details, businesses await clarity on how the incoming American tariff structures will shape bilateral commerce. The eventual signing of this accord will mark a critical milestone for cross-border trade and manufacturing partnerships.

big_story.headline: Navy Upgrades Barak Missile Shield via ₹1,976 Crore Deal
big_story.text: India has signed a ₹1,976 crore deal with Israel Aerospace Industries to upgrade the Indian Navy's Barak missile defence system. This strategic agreement strengthens maritime security and enhances defence cooperation between India and Israel. The deal highlights India's ongoing efforts to modernize its naval defence capabilities against evolving regional security threats.

big_story.headline: Fairfax to Exit IIFL Finance in ₹3,454 Crore Stake Sale
big_story.text: Investment firm Fairfax is set to exit IIFL Finance by selling its stake for ₹3,454 crore. The major divestment marks a significant portfolio reshuffle for the foreign investor in India's financial sector. This large transaction reflects shifting institutional capital flows and reshapes the ownership landscape of Indian non-banking financial companies.

venture_vault.headline: Botsync Secures $11 Million Led by IvyCap Ventures
venture_vault.text: Robotics startup Botsync has raised $11 million in a funding round led by IvyCap Ventures to scale its operations. The capital infusion will help the company expand its automated robotics solutions across manufacturing and logistics sectors. This funding underscores growing investor trust in Indian deep-tech and industrial automation innovations.

venture_vault.headline: Fatehpuria Hygiene Raises ₹100 Crore Led by Madhu Kela
venture_vault.text: Fatehpuria Hygiene has secured ₹100 crore in its maiden equity funding round led by prominent investor Madhu Kela. The fresh capital will drive product expansion and market penetration for the hygiene brand. The deal highlights rising investor appetite for consumer hygiene products and fast-growing Indian retail enterprises.

geopolitics.headline: Landmark India-EU Free Trade Agreement Set for December Signing
geopolitics.text: India and the European Union are set to sign their long-awaited Free Trade Agreement in December 2026. The landmark pact aims to reduce tariffs and streamline bilateral commerce across key economic sectors. For India, this agreement promises expanded market access to European economies and enhanced foreign direct investment flows.

geopolitics.headline: Bulk Scotch Imports Face 162.5% Tax Despite India-UK Trade Deal
geopolitics.text: Liquor firms in India face major disruption as bulk Scotch imports are now hit with a 162.5% tax despite the ongoing India-UK trade pact negotiations. Industry players expressed alarm over the sudden tariff burden affecting spirit bottling operations. The move underscores persistent tax frictions and regulatory hurdles in finalizing bilateral commercial agreements.
